messages.content: You are a computational biologist. Given a CRISPR screen description, produce a ranked list of 100 gene symbols (HGNC nomenclature for Homo sapiens) that you believe are MOST LIKELY to be hits in this screen, ordered strongest first. Use only your knowledge of biology — no chain-of-thought in the output. Return ONLY a comma-separated list of 100 symbols, no prose, no numbering.

## Goal

You are tasked with ranking genes from a genetic perturbation screen. Based on the experimental context and hit criteria provided below, provide a list of exactly 100 genes that are hits in this screen, ranked from strongest to weakest according to the criteria defined below.

## Experimental Context

This screen was performed in HT-29 cells, a Colonic Adenocarcinoma Cell Line. Researchers used a CRISPRn library (Knockout) to systematically perturb gene function. The experiment followed a Drug Exposure design and was conducted over 10 Days under Dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) treatment.

## Screen Objective

The primary objective of this screen was to identify a set of hit genes, each of which decrease cell proliferation in DMSO-treated control conditions.

## Hit Definition

A gene is classified as a "hit" if its Knockout significantly decrease cell proliferation in DMSO-treated control conditions. The statistical criterion for significance is: Beta Score < 0.0 AND FDR < 0.01.

## Ranking Criteria

Genes with low Beta Score, low FDR are ranked most highly.

## Additional Context
Screen notes: A CRISPR screen was carried out to identify affected genes in the DSMO treated cells as a control. The top gene hits with an FDR < 0.01 are noted. Negative beta scores indicate depleted genes and positive beta scores indicate enriched genes

## Required Output Format

Provide your response as an ordered list of exactly 100 HGNC gene symbols, using the ranking criteria above.
That is, top genes should have low Beta Score, low FDR.

Format: 
GENE1, GENE2, GENE3, ..., GENE100

=== Final instruction ===
Return ONLY a comma-separated list of 100 gene symbols (no prose, no numbers, no markdown). All gene symbols must use the HGNC convention for Homo sapiens (e.g. 'TP53' for HGNC, 'Trp53' for MGI). Do not return symbols from another organism.
